parts:
Data?  It would be much easier to work with with some data.  See ?dput or have a look at https://github.com/hadley/devtools/wiki/Reproducibility.

dput(Singlespp) should be what we would like to see.

If nothing else something like

nn  <-  c("Plectropomus.spp","Hipposcarus.longiceps","Naso.unicornis",
          "Lutjanus.gibbus")
gsub("[.]"," ",nn)

should get rid of the '.'s.

On Friday, June 7, 2013 2:48:49 AM UTC-4, ger...@gmail.com wrote:
I only have only just finished a R course so apologies if this isn't posted properly or is a stupid question.
I need to get the labels for the facets labelled:"Plectropomus.spp","Hipposcarus.longiceps","Naso.unicornis","Lutjanus.gibbus" that you can see in the figure below in italics as well as remove the "." and replace with a space. I also don't want to simply ask it to replace the labels with text that I have to type manually as I would like to change the species in the plot without having to change the names each time.

The other problem I had is when I add the "width=" into the line "plots <- ggplot(Singlespp, aes(x = Harvest, y = value)" it has no effect no matter what value I give it. I would like to make the bars slightly skinnier.

Any advice would be much appreciated?

Singlespp <- subset(AllDataMelt, species %in% c("Plectropomus.spp","Hipposcarus.longiceps","Naso.unicornis","Lutjanus.gibbus"))
# Reorder factor
Singlespp$Harvest <- factor(Singlespp$Harvest, levels = rev(levels(Singlespp$Harvest)))

pos <- position_dodge(width = 0.9)

se <- function(x) sd(x) / sqrt(length(x) )
se.min <- function(x) mean(x) - se(x)
se.max <- function(x) mean(x) + se(x)


plots <- ggplot(Singlespp, aes(x = Harvest, y = value)) +
  stat_summary(aes(fill = Technique), fun.y = mean, geom = 'bar', position = pos) +
  stat_summary(aes(group = Technique), fun.ymin=se.min,
               fun.ymax = se.max, geom = 'errorbar', width = 0.5,
               position = pos) +
  facet_grid(species ~ Status,scales="free_y")+ylab("Mean Abundance")+ theme_bw()+scale_fill_grey(start=0,end=0.8)
plots
